name: rsi-jev-0.8b
code_path: GitHub Shanghua-Gao/RSI-Jev@8f34a4f2afadba288e77905eeeec1f22ac3a0981 scripts/serve.py --ckpt <HF shgao/rsi-jev-v1.0-qwen3.5-0.8b@f9248caceb89caf2e6c968ea33bf0d6eb7f957b0> (load_release; base Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base@dc7cdfe); venv servers/venvs/a-rsi
params_source: launcher probe servers/logs/rsi-jev-0.8b.params.json (DecisionModel): Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base text tower incl. embeddings 752,393,024 + option_xattn scorer 7,348,225
notes: Authors' own server as is: tower bf16, scorer fp32. v1.0 ships no calibration file. The encoder's max_length is 2048; above it the authors' code silently cuts the state from the left instead of answering 422. 35 of the 231 public items (long_policy, multi_hop) were cut this way, so some answers come from truncated input. Served with --served-model-name rsi-jev-0.8b and --accept-model local. Option keys are visible to the model.

name: systemone-lite-0.5b
notes: Matches the author's self-reported 50.7%. fp16 on CUDA. Scores only the FIRST token of each option key, so keys sharing a first token get identical probabilities (in UNO: same-colour card ids tie, wild ties with wild_draw4). The request 'model' field is a model id to load; symlinks in servers/src/a-s1lite-models/ map the harness and ping names to the pinned snapshot. Input is cut at 4096 tokens on the right instead of 422; no JevBench item hit it.

name: qwen3.5-0.8b-decision
code_path: HF mghafiri/qwen3.5-0.8B-decision-model@4a9939034a27006b4b62ad5aed65a90b82d0d350, bundled jevlite.model.SystemOne, wrapped by servers/adapters/mghafiri_decision.py; venv a-rsi
params_source: serve.py count of the modules load() returned (Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, tied embeddings) -> servers/logs/qwen3.5-0.8b-decision.params.json
notes: English-only. bf16 with per-type temperatures from calibration.json. Hard cap of 52 options (A-Z, a-z). jevlite silently drops the middle of prompts above 3072 tokens; the adapter answers 422 instead, which caused the 8 failures (over-long hard long_policy items). Accuracy on the 223 answered items: 0.596; failures count as wrong.

name: tiny-jev-0.6b
code_path: HF lostargon/Tiny-Jev@62449fb3272d68fb8c8fe8a33082566643a76d0b, AutoModel trust_remote_code (TinyJevModel), wrapped by servers/adapters/tiny_jev.py; venv a-rsi
params_source: serve.py count of TinyJevModel -> servers/logs/tiny-jev-0.6b.params.json (Qwen3-0.6B stack + 1,025-parameter head; matches the card's 596M)
notes: bf16 as shipped. Their noul API takes no criteria, so noul criteria are not shown to the model. 4096-token context enforced as 422 instead of their silent truncation; no item hit it. Very strong on easy/original (48/48, 56/72), weak on hard (29/111).

name: openjev-nli-0.8b
code_path: HF AlexWortega/openjev@26de23c44b67586b4bea31c0ef2e016e3068ae66, subfolder qwen3.5-0.8b-nli-v2s-long + code/; OpenJev.decide on OpenJevCrossEncoder, wrapped by servers/adapters/openjev_nli.py; venv a-rsi
params_source: serve.py count of the Qwen3_5ForSequenceClassification the authors' loader holds: text 752,393,024 + NLI head 3,072 + unused vision tower 100,592,896
notes: LIKELY CONTAMINATED on JevBench public items: fine-tuned from 'qwen3.5-0.8b-nli-v2s-jev', whose data mix ('jevfmt') trains on the JevBench public items x8 unless --no-jevbench (used only for v3/v4/v5 per the authors). NLI cross-encoder: one forward pass per option; answers independent of option order. bf16. 4096 tokens per (state, option) pair enforced as 422.
